'''Soft wheat''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[Mill|milled]] into [[Flour|soft wheat flour]] or [[Still|brewed]] into [[Alcohol|soft wheat beer]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] soft wheat for its ''beer''.
